purpose: One fixed synthetic Linux lifecycle validation, not a new ATPG/training experiment
sandbox_preconditions: Dedicated PID namespace; the gate Python process is PID 1
Standard read-only cgroup2 mount with fixed limits already installed outside the gate
Only gate PID in cgroup.procs and pids.current=1 before each profile and after completion
No network, GPU, repository/data/checkpoint mounts, host namespace, privileged mode or new capability
Only exact reviewed script read-only and <=1 MiB scratch tmpfs; stdout/stderr combined <=16 KiB
No installation, image pull, build, host cgroup modification or limit increase

proposed_whole_execution_package.reason: This request is separate from exhausted E70 read-only quota and previous consumed synthetic validations
proposed_whole_execution_package.local_linux_probe: WSL unavailable; docker command not found on current Windows client
proposed_whole_execution_package.candidate_endpoint: Existing verified B endpoint cjc@gpuserver.buptic.top only
proposed_whole_execution_package.image_selection: Choose one already-present Python-capable image and pin immutable image ID/digest before creation; if none exists, stop without pull/build
steps_under_single_authorization: Bounded existing Docker/Python image metadata inspection only
Freeze exact image ID, source SHA and container resource/options manifest
Independent read-only final execution review and fresh endpoint/resource gates
Create at most one isolated nonprivileged no-network container, run exact three-profile script once
Capture bounded result/exit/container state and SHA; timeout or incomplete cleanup stops without retry
Seal small overview/receipts and normally commit/push existing origin/main without reasking each local step
proposed_whole_execution_package.container_cleanup: On failure/timeout stop only the exact newly-created container ID; preserve its exit/identity receipt; do not delete unrelated containers/images or overwrite existing output directories

evidence_limits.pure_snapshot_gate: Consistency check only; caller-supplied flags do not authenticate kernel state
evidence_limits.linux_gate: Fixed non-daemonizing Python process-group scope only, not a universal daemon/process-tree termination guarantee
evidence_limits.memory: Reads actual configured kernel limits; no active OOM stress and no production ATPG memory certification
evidence_limits.timing: Before-Popen to cleanup interval includes dispatch and polling; not E65 exclusive atomic ATPG cost
evidence_limits.durable_runner: Not integrated with durable prelaunch/reap journal; a pass cannot release production capture
